titre: Le marché hypothécaire américain sort de son creux
sous_titre: Volume annuel des crédits immobiliers résidentiels accordés aux États-Unis, en milliers de Mds $, 2024 à 2026

2024.texte: Total volume in 2025 is expected to increase to $2.08 trillion, up 17 percent from $1.78 trillion in 2024.

2025.texte: total single-family mortgage origination volume is expected to increase to $2.2 trillion in 2026 from $2.0 trillion expected in 2025.

2026.texte: Purchase originations are forecast to increase 7.7% to $1.46 trillion next year and refinance originations are expected to increase 9.2% to $737 billion.
